_comment: Per-platform behaviour learned by PlatformAgentTrainer. best_hours are Asia/Karachi local hours; the trainer adjusts them from real reply timestamps as data accumulates. daily_limit is enforced by the permission gate (never exceed it - accounts get banned).

whatsapp.style: short, personal, Salam se shuru, ek sawaal par khatam
whatsapp.opener_pattern: Salam {owner_title}{owner_name}, main ne {business_name} ki site dekhi. {issue}. {benefit}. {question}
whatsapp.notes: WhatsApp sab se tez channel hai Pakistan mein. 1-to-1 feel zaroori hai - template jaisa na lage. Emoji 1 se zyada nahi.
templates: Salam! {business_name} ki site dekhi - {issue}. Is se {benefit}. Kya main 2 minute mein bataoon ke ye kaise theek hota hai?
{owner_name} bhai, {business_name} ke liye ek chhoti baat: {issue}. {benefit}. Free mockup bana kar bhejoon? Pasand na aaye to koi paisa nahi.

linkedin.style: professional, English ya Roman Urdu, value-first, koi sales pitch nahi pehle message mein
linkedin.opener_pattern: Hi {first_name}, saw {company} is {observation}. We recently {result} for a {category} in {city}. Curious - {question}
linkedin.notes: LinkedIn pe pehla message kabhi pitch nahi hota. Pehle connect + observation, doosre message mein audit finding, teesre mein mockup offer.
templates: Hi {first_name} - noticed {company}'s site loads in about {seconds}s on mobile. We got a similar {category} in {city} down to {target}s and their enquiries went up. Happy to share what we changed, no strings.
{first_name}, {company} ranks well locally but the site has no LocalBusiness schema - that's usually why Maps and search disagree. Want the 3-line fix?

facebook.style: casual, community tone, comment pehle (public proof), DM baad mein
facebook.opener_pattern: {comment_public} ... baad mein DM: Salam! {business_name} ki site dekhi, {issue}. {question}
facebook.notes: Groups mein seedha pitch mat karo - pehle comment mein asli madad do, phir DM. Page reviews par reply dena bhi lead source hai.
templates: Bilkul sahi kaha aap ne. By the way, {business_name} ki site mobile pe theek nahi khul rahi - main ne check kiya to {issue} tha. Chhota fix hai.
Salam! Aap ki page se {business_name} dekha. Ek cheez: {issue}. Is se {benefit}. Free mockup bhejoon?

instagram.style: bohat short, emoji kam, story reply ya DM - pehle genuine compliment
instagram.notes: Instagram par log 3 second decide karte hain. Pehli line mein compliment ya specific observation. Link pehle message mein mat bhejo - DM collapse ho jata hai.
templates: Aap ka {category} content bohat acha hai! Ek cheez notice hui: aap ki site pe {issue}. Is se {benefit}. Free mockup bana doon?
{business_name} ke photos dekhe - bohat achay. Bas site mobile pe slow hai ({seconds}s). 2 minute hain to bataoon?

email.style: subject line mein specific number ya business ka naam, body mein 3 short paragraphs
subject_patterns: {business_name} ki site mobile pe {seconds}s leti hai
email.notes: Email WhatsApp ka backup hai - sirf tab bhejo jab WhatsApp number na ho ya 2 follow-ups ke baad jawab na aaye. Subject line sab kuch hai.
